actual_log_outlier_selection.circularity_audit: The time tau is selected from the fixed core eigenvector and actual M_A before inspecting G_W's top eigenvector, deletion statistic, phase rounding, or Farey outcome.
actual_log_outlier_selection.elementary_average: (1/|I|)integral_I|D_c(tau)|^2dtau<=C_v:=1+32L(1+log L)/H, so a tau in I has |f(tau)|^2<=Lambda*C_v.
actual_log_outlier_selection.large_v_constant: For v>=64, C_v<=2 by log(v)<=sqrt(v) and L/H=v^(-2).

claim_boundary: This artifact proves a conditional actual-log/Farey one-row surgery theorem. It does not construct its surplus/spectral core, refute RFDI, establish the full Base pointwise coefficient condition after surgery, prove an actual CRR witness, AFARI/FARI/CFARI/CRR-U, a cubic estimate, a density gain, a short-interval theorem, a saturation theorem, or an L-function result.

conditional_core.boundary: No existence theorem for this core is supplied; it is an explicit conditional antecedent, not an actual counterexample to RFDI.
conditional_core.geometry: A has R-1 rows in [0,H/4], is H^(1/100)-separated, and has E(A) in [v^(20-delta(v)),v^(20+delta(v))-(4R-3)].
conditional_core.rationalmass_surplus: On a rational set E of measure at least v^(-4-delta(v)), F_A>=(1+epsilon)*v^(12-2*delta(v)) for fixed epsilon>0.
conditional_core.spectral: lambda_1(G_A)=Lambda, lambda_2(G_A)<=(1-g)Lambda, Lambda>=v^(12-ell*delta(v)), and S_L+sqrt(Lambda*S_L)<=g*Lambda/2 for fixed 0<g<=1.

context.common_object_rule: One common pair (b,W) must satisfy Base(v), RationalMass(v), and PositiveCubic(v); no separately optimized W is admissible.
context.smoothing: psi1>=0; supp(psi1) subset [-1,1]; psi1(0)=1; psi2>=0; supp(psi2) subset [1/2,3/2]; psi2(1)=1

farey_kernel_rows.actual_labels: C_theta(sk,rk)=R_W((r/s)*exp(theta/H)) remains an identity for the one common W.
farey_kernel_rows.feature: Phi_t(a,theta)=(a*exp(theta/H))^(i*t), so K_F is a Gram kernel

mean_value_rows.selection: There exists tau in I with |D_c(tau)|^2<=C_v.
mean_value_rows.simple_large_v_bound: For v>=64, C_v<=2, using log v<=sqrt(v) and L/H=v^(-2).

outlier_windows.energy_increment_derivation: For |A|=R-1 and unit-separated A, E(A union {tau})=E(A)+4|A|+1=E(A)+4R-3.

rationalmass_surplus_rows.conclusion: The same E proves the frozen RationalMass(v) predicate for A union {tau}; no new set of rational cells is selected.
rationalmass_surplus_rows.core_surplus: F_A(u)>=(1+epsilon)*T_v on a rational set E of measure at least v^(-4-delta(v))
rationalmass_surplus_rows.sufficient_size: If T_v>=max(2,8*(1+epsilon)/epsilon^2), then the core surplus implies F_(A union {tau})(u)>=T_v on E.

spectral_surgery_rows.asymptotic_failure: For fixed g,ell,s, the last bound is <v^(-2*s*delta(v)) for all sufficiently large v.
spectral_surgery_rows.top_coordinate: For every unit top eigenvector u_W, |(u_W)_tau|^2<=4*C_v/(g^2*Lambda)

falsifiers.actual_log: A sign/orientation error in the expansion of f(tau), the integral/log-spacing bound, or the harmonic estimate refutes the actual-row selection lemma.
falsifiers.energy: A failure of the pair-sum class separation or of E(A union {tau})=E(A)+4R-3 refutes the scalar-preservation lemma.
falsifiers.rationalmass: A failure of the pinned smoothing positivity/support bound J<=2 or of the Cauchy estimate refutes the RationalMass-preservation lemma.
falsifiers.scope: An actual proof that no core meets the listed antecedents changes the research route but does not refute this conditional theorem.
falsifiers.spectral: A block matrix satisfying the stated core gap and scale condition but violating the top-coordinate or DelCov bound refutes the spectral surgery lemma.

research_stage_review_policy.lightweight_checks: exact row/Gram algebra, elementary integral and harmonic estimates, frozen source/convention anchors, rational scale bookkeeping, replay, and tamper rejection

row_deletion_failure.block_gap: ||B||<=Lambda-gLambda/2 in the [u_A] direct-sum complement decomposition of G_W.
row_deletion_failure.rfd_failure: For any fixed g,ell,s, this is <v^(-2s*delta(v)) for all sufficiently large v, so the deletion half of RFDI_(s,kappa) fails independently of kappa.
row_deletion_failure.top_coordinate: For every unit top eigenvector u_W, |(u_W)_tau|^2<=4C_v/(g^2Lambda).

scalar_and_farey_preservation.farey: The actual K_F feature identity and C_theta(sk,rk)=R_W((r/s)*exp(theta/H)) remain attached to this same W; no alias or row-set replacement is made.

farey_rows.actual_labels: C_theta(sk,rk)=R_W((r/s)*exp(theta/H)) remains an identity for the one common W.
farey_rows.feature: Phi_t(a,theta)=(a*exp(theta/H))^(i*t), so K_F is a Gram kernel

scalar_and_farey_preservation.outlier_window: tau is selected in [3H/4,H], so W=A union {tau} is one common actual row set.
scalar_and_farey_preservation.rationalmass: F_W(u)>=F_A(u)-2sqrt(2F_A(u)); if v^(12-2delta(v))>=max(2,8(1+epsilon)/epsilon^2), the same rational set E proves RationalMass(v) for W.
scalar_and_farey_preservation.separation_cardinality_energy: E(W)=E(A)+4R-3; the displayed core interior energy band gives the frozen Base separation/cardinality/energy predicates for W.

structural_consequence.not_a_no_go: This does not say the full Base/RationalMass/PositiveCubic witness class admits the core, nor that RFDI is false.
structural_consequence.statement: A set-only RFDI proof cannot use only scalar/hereditary properties preserved by this surgery. It must exploit an all-row log/Farey mechanism, exclude the isolated-core configuration, or use the non-hereditary coefficient/pointwise portion of Base.
